title: Comment Thread Count
prompt: A discussion page stores comments with nested replies. Write a function that counts every comment in the thread, including all replies at every depth.

explanation.beginner:
Example: commentThreadCount([{"id":"1","replies":[{"id":"1a"},{"id":"1b"}]},{"id":"2"}]) produces 4. The result must follow this precise rule: A discussion page stores comments with nested replies. Write a function that counts every comment in the thread, including all replies at every depth. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “handles no comments”: input [[]] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.
